data.name: Sleepless
data.description: A dreamstalker gains immunity to sleep effects and a +%1 bonus on saving throws against fatigue and exhaustion. She loses both benefits when under an effect that would prevent her from providing an emotion component (Occult Adventures 144).|CHA
